restart_policy_deviation: User explicitly requested a fresh complete matrix after process interruption, including previously completed configurations; not an additional independent traffic sample

secondary.claim: Continuous effect/cost tradeoff; no equivalence or noninferiority margin

statistics.averaging: attack seeds within checkpoint/traffic, then five fixed checkpoints within traffic
statistics.resampling_unit: traffic seed; jointly paired across methods, budgets and checkpoints

bootstrap.interpretation: Approximate conditional intervals, not a proof of significance

statistics.fgsm: 250 actual episodes; broadcast deterministic paired outcomes only, never costs or sample N
statistics.clean: 250 canonical episodes from basic_attack0; other Clean episodes are integrity checks
statistics.safety: Original SUMO collision definition; episode minimum TTC and TTC p5 / DRAC p95 with valid counts and nulls; do not present averaged episode percentiles as pooled percentiles
statistics.reporting: All 17 method/budget rows; negative cases and traffic concentration; no post-test model/config selection

limitations: 50 traffic clusters, five fixed checkpoints, correlated attack repeats; same original scenario. Observation box is not physical plausibility. No guaranteed safety/efficiency/novelty claim.

comparisons.interpretation: First minus second. Conditional on five fixed models; correlated attack repeats are averaged, not independent traffic samples.

collision_conversion.definition: Average three correlated attacks within each fixed model/traffic pair; units may be fractional, not independent events
